gbm_population_evidence.quote: Have radiographic suspicion of newly diagnosed glioblastoma (GBM).

candidate_evidence.quote: GammaTiles are a U.S. FDA-cleared, surgically targeted radiation therapy for patients with certain brain tumors. GammaTile consists of bioresorbable collagen tiles embedded with Cesium-131 (Cs-131) radioactive seeds
TMZ will be administered at a dose of 75 mg/m2/day orally for each Arm.

role_evidence.quote: TMZ will be administered at a dose of 75 mg/m2/day orally for each Arm.
TMZ (Chemotherapy) is used as a first-line treatment, often in combination with radiation therapy after surgical resection of the tumor

arms: Maximal safe resection followed by EBRT with concurrent TMZ followed by adjuvant TMZ (Arm A)
Maximal safe resection + GammaTile followed by EBRT with concurrent TMZ then adjuvant TMZ (Arm B)

source_quote.quote: A previous biopsy diagnosis other than IDH wild-type GBM.

coder_notes: Investigational intervention is GammaTile (Cs-131 brachytherapy device) with hypofractionated EBRT; device and radiotherapy are not listed as agents. Temozolomide is given in both arms (soc_backbone; EBRT course differs between arms but TMZ dose and schedule per cycle are the same). IDH-wildtype used to define GBM: IDH-mutant patients found at final pathology are followed for safety only and excluded from efficacy analyses; recorded as IDH eligibility, not candidate-matched.
